evals.prompt:
I OCR'd a scanned report and got this mess, can you turn it into proper markdown? Here's the text:

ANNUAL SAFETY RE-
PORT

Executive Summary
This report covers incidents record-
ed during the 2023 fiscal year across
all three plant sites.

1 of 4

• Total incidents: 12
• Lost-time incidents: 2
• Near misses reported: 34

Recommendations
1) Increase safety training frequency
2) Install additional signage in Zone B
3) Review PPE compliance monthly

ANNUAL SAFETY RE-
PORT

2 of 4

Site Breakdown
Site     Incidents   Near Misses
Plant A     5              12
Plant B     4              15
Plant C     3              7
evals.expected_output: A markdown document with a top-level heading 'Annual Safety Report', rejoined hyphenated words (Re-\nPORT -> Report, record-\ned -> recorded), the repeated running header and page-number lines ('ANNUAL SAFETY RE-PORT', '1 of 4', '2 of 4') removed, a proper bullet list for the summary stats, a numbered list for recommendations, and a real markdown table with header row and separator for the site breakdown.

evals.prompt:

Project Kickoff Notes

● Launch target is set for Q3, not Q2 as originally discussed

evals.expected_output: Markdown with '# Project Kickoff Notes' as the title, '## Attendees', '## Key Decisions', '## Open Questions', '## Next Steps' as section headings, bullet lists using '-' (converted from the ● glyph) for Attendees and Key Decisions, and a '1.' ordered list for Next Steps. evals.prompt: Here's some text I pasted from a PDF export of a recipe. It's a wall of text with no structure — can you turn it into a clean markdown recipe? "Grandma's Chili Serves 6 Ingredients 2 lbs ground beef 1 large onion diced 2 cans kidney beans 1 can crushed tomatoes 2 tbsp chili powder Instructions Brown the beef in a large pot over medium heat Add the onion and cook until soft about 5 minutes Stir in the chili powder and cook for 1 minute Add the beans and tomatoes and simmer for 30 minutes"
evals.expected_output: A markdown document with '# Grandma's Chili', a note that it serves 6, an '## Ingredients' section as a bullet list, and an '## Instructions' section as a numbered list — reconstructed from a single unbroken paragraph with no punctuation cues between items, without inventing quantities or steps that weren't in the source.
